manual.title: Aqua Illumination light
manual.description: Enter the light's IP address (give it a DHCP reservation so it never moves). For linked lights, use the parent.

search.title: Search my network
search.description: Leave blank to scan this Home Assistant's own network, or list networks such as 192.168.1.0/24 (space separated).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach an Aqua Illumination light at that address.
error.not_parent: That light is a child of a linked pair - use the parent light's address.
error.bad_network: That is not a valid network (use e.g. 192.168.1.0/24).
error.none_found: No new lights answered. Check it is powered and on the same network.

abort.already_configured: That light is already set up.
abort.not_parent: That light is a child of a linked pair - set up the parent.

data.auto_clock: Keep the light's clock correct automatically
data.night_feed_channels: Night feeding channels (none ticked = the red channels)
